Partly fixed, and my earlier ruling on it was WRONG. Recording the correction, because I told the user this bead would be fixed wholesale and that was based on an incomplete read.

What I said: pkix-chain-simple has eight purpose-built error variants plus one odd Path(PathError) passthrough, and the passthrough undercuts the design of a crate whose job is narrowing. Fix it.

What is actually there: Path is not an odd passthrough, it is the PRIMARY RESULT CHANNEL. Line 485 is

    pkix_path::validate_path(chain, anchors, &policy, &DefaultVerifier).map_err(Error::Path)

This crate does not implement RFC 5280 validation. It applies its own narrow gates first -- empty chain, chain too long, no anchors, disallowed signature algorithm, unhandled critical extension, unexpected extension, missing required extension, leaf is a CA -- and then DELEGATES the validation. Every one of the eight own variants is a refusal of input before validation runs; Path carries the verdict of the validation itself.

So flattening Path would mean mirroring every pkix_path::Error variant into this crate and tracking it forever, to re-describe work this crate does not do. That is the maintenance tax, paid for nothing. The bead premise -- that wrapping is a leak -- does not hold where the wrapped crate is doing the job being reported on.

What WAS worth fixing, and is: three sites inside this crate OWN gates (BasicConstraints and KeyUsage decoding) reported a DER decode failure as Path(pkix_path::Error::from(der_error)). That attributed a local gate refusal to the delegated validator, which is the one place the bead instinct was right. They now return the new Error::MalformedExtension { index }, matching every other local refusal. Commit b00699e2.

Net: Path stays, correctly, for the delegated verdict. The three local decode failures moved into this crate own vocabulary where they belonged.

Consistent with PKIX-rm8.5 and PKIX-sqek.27, closed as correct-by-design for pkix-chain, though for a different reason: there the vocabulary is already shared by design; here the validation itself is delegated.

Gates green: fmt, clippy, rustdoc, 2357 tests, workspace feature powerset clean.
